name: Water Front Bungalow (#1)
description:
Unlimited drinking water, stand up paddle boards, and fast Starlink internet. We offer a wash and fold laundry service,  9am-3pm, Monday - Friday. Not available on check out day. One free load per week. Walking distance to all the restaurants and grocery stores in Bocas Town, yet tucked away in a quiet corner of town with sunset views and swimming right off the dock. This sweet waterfront bungalow is brand new, and located in a high end, vacation rental complex.

This bungalow is a studio apartment with full kitchen and bathroom, king size bed, private patio that extends down to a huge shared sundeck with tables and sun loungers. It’s located inside a high end, vacation rental complex and offers free laundry service, unlimited drinking water, and access to paddle boards and a kayak.

The Bungalow is located in a property that is shared with other rental units. Your bungalow is completely private, and you have your own private patio with two chairs and little tables. The large sun deck by the water is shared with other guests, but there are plenty of tables and chairs for everyone. You can swim from the deck and there is a ladder and a shower to rinse off.

We have staff on site during the day most days, however we have self check in and check out. We are available for anything you need, including arranging tours and offering travel tips.

We are very close to the airport, 2 minutes by taxi.

name: Centrally located Caribbean Apartment on the Sea
description:
Unlimited drinking water, stand up paddle boards, and fast Starlink internet. We offer a wash and fold laundry service, 9am-3pm, Monday - Friday. Not available on check out day. One free load per week. Walking distance to all the restaurants and grocery stores in Bocas Town, yet tucked away in a quiet corner of town with sunset views and swimming right off the dock. This sweet apartment is located in a high end, vacation rental complex.

This is a two bedroom apartment which is located in a boutique 3 unit BnB. Your apartment and Patio are completely private, but there are two other units on the property. There is a shared lower deck that can be used by all guests, to enjoy some sun or take a swim. Quiet time is from 10pm to 8am.

You’ll be able to access your apartment as well as the lower sun deck. We offer a free, wash and fold, laundry service. Just send us a message on the app and drop your laundry off with us. We will have it washed and folded for you as quickly as possible.

We provide full assistance during your stay. We have staff on the property during the day to help you with anything you need. If you arrive late, self check in is easy with key code locks on the doors. We want your stay in Bocas to be the best it can be, we can help you arrange all of your activities and transportation.

The neighborhood is amazing, it's a more quiet part of town. There is a park for children directly across the street with a few benches to sit and relax. Grocery stores and restaurants are a short walk away. There are also stores with toiletries and other essentials nearby. Bocas Town is very safe, however, just like any city, you must be aware and use common sense.

Bocas Town is a walkable town, however you might want to rent a bike to explore the rest of the island. There are also lots of taxis that can take you anywhere quickly, many of which are pick up trucks so they can take your surf boards and luggage and even your bikes if you get tired. There are also ATVs for rent from Flying Tigers ATV rentals, you can go everywhere on Isla Colon and explore off road jungle trails and beaches. The rest of the Archipelago can only be accessed by boat. Ask your host about setting up a tour or water taxi transportation. You can come and go right from the dock at the house. There are also many water taxi companies on 1st street a short walk away.
